{{- /* creator/home.html — home page (arch/26 §2.2). Aggregation lives here because Foundry shortcodes cannot reach .Site. 1. Hero: heroTitle/heroSubtitle (jasper keys) → .Title/.Description → .Site.Title; body as lede. 2. Featured: root-folder notes ∪ featured: true, deduped, weight → date; masonry cards. 3. One section per top-level folder (streams excluded): latest 10 notes as rows. 4. Streams: latest 5 entries each. */ -}} {{- $_ := partial "creator/nodes.html" . -}}{{- $nodes := .Scratch.Get "creatorNodes" -}} {{- $notes := where $nodes "g" 1 -}} {{- $title := .Params.heroTitle | default .Title | default .Site.Title -}} {{- $sub := .Params.heroSubtitle | default .Description -}} {{- /* Featured = root notes ∪ featured:true (no union in dist → dedupe by slug). */ -}} {{- $featured := slice -}} {{- $seen := dict -}} {{- range $notes -}} {{- if and (or (eq .parent "") .featured) (not (index $seen .slug)) -}} {{- $seen = merge $seen (dict .slug true) -}} {{- $featured = $featured | append . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $featured = partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" $featured "by" "cards") | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $folders := where (where $nodes "parent" "") "g" 0 -}} {{- $folders = partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" $folders "by" "menu") | transform.Unmarshal -}}

{{ $title }}

{{- with $sub }}

{{ . }}

{{ end }}
{{- with .WikilinkContent -}}
{{ . }}
{{- end -}}
{{- if $featured -}}

{{ i18n "creator.featured" }}

{{- range $featured -}}{{- partial "creator/card.html" (dict "node" . "kind" "auto") -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- if $folders -}}

{{ i18n "creator.garden" }}

{{- range $f := $folders -}} {{- $prefix := printf "%s/" $f.slug -}} {{- $items := slice -}} {{- range $notes -}}{{- if strings.HasPrefix .slug $prefix -}}{{- $items = $items | append . -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}} {{- $items = partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" $items "by" "date") | transform.Unmarshal -}}
{{ partial "creator/folder-icon.html" (dict "node" $f "size" 22) }}

{{ $f.title }}

{{- partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "arrow-right" "size" 18 "class" "cr-section-arrow") -}} {{- with $f.desc }}

{{ . }}

{{ end }} {{- if $f.stream -}}
    {{- range first 5 $items -}} {{- $label := .title -}}{{- if and (not .hasTitle) .fdateText -}}{{- $label = .fdateText -}}{{- end -}}
  • {{ $label }}{{ partial "creator/dates.html" (dict "iso" .date "text" .dateText "rel" true) }}
    • {{- end -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- range first 10 $items -}}{{- partial "creator/card.html" (dict "node" . "kind" "row") -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- if gt (len $items) 0 -}} {{ i18n "creator.viewAll" }} {{ $f.n }} {{ partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "arrow-right" "size" 16) }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- partial "subscribe.html" (dict "Page" . "variant" "full" "placement" "home") -}}
